# Treasury data values (in millions)
europe_1991 = 268166
latam_1991 = 337565
europe_1996 = 426245
latam_1996 = 443872

# Linear regression with Europe as predictor of Latin America
# Using two points: (268166, 337565) and (426245, 443872)
slope = (latam_1996 - latam_1991) / (europe_1996 - europe_1991)
intercept = latam_1991 - slope * europe_1991

print(f"Slope: {slope}")
print(f"Intercept: {intercept}")

# Germany GDP (in billions, from World Bank)
gdp_1991 = 1875.79  # World Bank value
gdp_1996 = 2506.58  # World Bank value

print(f"\nGermany GDP 1991: {gdp_1991} billion")
print(f"Germany GDP 1996: {gdp_1996} billion")

# Germany's percentage growth rate
germany_growth_rate = (gdp_1996 - gdp_1991) / gdp_1991
print(f"Germany growth rate: {germany_growth_rate * 100:.4f}%")

# Apply growth rate to June 1991 Europe value (counterfactual)
europe_1991_counterfactual = europe_1991 * (1 + germany_growth_rate)
print(f"\nCounterfactual Europe 1996: {europe_1991_counterfactual}")

# Use regression to predict Latin America for counterfactual Europe
latam_predicted_counterfactual = slope * europe_1991_counterfactual + intercept
print(f"Predicted Latin America (counterfactual): {latam_predicted_counterfactual}")

# Absolute difference from actual June 1996 Latin America
abs_diff = abs(latam_predicted_counterfactual - latam_1996)
print(f"\nAbsolute difference: {abs_diff}")

# Express as percentage of actual June 1996 value
pct_of_actual = (abs_diff / latam_1996) * 100
print(f"Percentage of actual: {pct_of_actual:.4f}%")

# U.S. total liabilities growth (Europe + Latin America & Caribbean)
us_liabilities_1991 = europe_1991 + latam_1991
us_liabilities_1996 = europe_1996 + latam_1996
us_growth_rate = (us_liabilities_1996 - us_liabilities_1991) / us_liabilities_1991

print(f"\nU.S. liabilities 1991: {us_liabilities_1991}")
print(f"U.S. liabilities 1996: {us_liabilities_1996}")
print(f"U.S. growth rate: {us_growth_rate * 100:.4f}%")

# Ratio of U.S. growth to Germany growth
ratio = us_growth_rate / germany_growth_rate
print(f"Ratio: {ratio:.4f}")

# Final calculation
final_result = pct_of_actual * ratio
print(f"\nFinal result: {final_result:.2f}")
EOF
